load_yaml_with_base: load a YAML config file that inherits attributes from a base config using the _BASE_ key
merge_from_file: merge configuration values from a YAML file into an existing CfgNode instance with base config support
merge_from_other_cfg: merge another CfgNode instance into the current config node while validating reserved keys
merge_from_list: merge configuration values from a flat key-value list into the current CfgNode instance
set_computed_attribute: set a COMPUTED_ prefixed attribute on a frozen CfgNode that allows insertion-only semantics
